Estonia Urges EU Against Banning Children From Social Media

Estonia has advised the European Union against implementing a ban on children's access to social media platforms. The Estonian government communicated this stance to the EU, suggesting an alternative approach to addressing concerns about minors' online activities. The specific details of Estonia's proposed alternative were not elaborated upon in the coverage.
